phases.summary:
Defines the crate purpose, non-goals, functional requirements (15 items), compliance constraints (MSRV 1.95, PJSIP 2.17), module structure, versioning policy, and domain terminology — the foundational specification that all subsequent implementation phases build upon.
---
Defines the four execution contexts (User async, Core reactor, PJSIP callbacks, Audio worker tasks), single-reactor thread model, and command serialization via unbounded MPSC channels — the threading foundation for all crate components.
---
Implements the crate purpose, RuntimeCommand serialization, complete error design (SipError/SipErrorKind), EventBus with dual control/raw-sip broadcast channels, NativeEvent to SipEventPayload conversion for all priority levels including CallState/CallMediaState/RegistrationStateChanged mapping, DtmfSent two-phase design, AudioWorkerTask source lifecycle, and Dual Client PJSIP callback routing with account_id-based event dispatch.
